card.name: Eye-drug text, mixed positions
card.fires_on: Ordinary linking words and punctuation inside eye-medicine label text, such as commas in kit contents, 'mg' in a combination tablet, or the end of 'ophthalmic'. A baseball passage also triggers it.

modes.label: Kit and syringe lists
modes.description: Commas, 'and' or a space inside lists of injection kit parts or needle sizes.

modes.label: Ophthalmic product wording
modes.description: The ending of 'ophthalmic' before solution or suspension.
modes.example: SIMBRINZA ophthalm<<ic>> suspension may be used concomitantly

modes.label: Baseball narration
modes.description: A word in a sports description of a throw.
